sources.note: Republishes the county's newsrooms (Tillamook County Pioneer, Headlight Herald, Pacific City Sun, Salmonberry Magazine et al.) filtered to Tillamook County, with headline, link, date, categories and the story's own photo. stories.title: Tualatin SWCD receives federal fish-passage money held up over paperwork
stories.summary: The Tualatin Soil and Water Conservation District received $610,953.03 on Nov. 4 for fish-passage work on Coffee and Finger creeks, tributaries of Gales Creek, more than a year after construction ended.

stories.title: Nehalem Council discusses watershed management plan
stories.summary: Nehalem City Council discussed the first draft of a watershed management plan that is currently being developed for city owned forestland containing the city’s drinking water sources on November 10.

stories.title: County leaders discuss annex fits
stories.summary: As part of ongoing discussions regarding how to use the county-owned, ex-Bureau of Land Management building on Third Street, county leaders reviewed two preliminary potential layouts for the building on November 10.
